description: This file is a shell script used for testing and demonstrating tail optimization techniques with functions like zs and zc, manipulating and comparing large strings, and using git diffs to verify output. It includes setup routines, pattern matching, and test cases for file diffs.

methods.name: zs
methods.description: Generates a repeated string pattern based on a numeric count, optimizing large repetitions by decreasing the count and printing predefined string segments.

methods.name: zc
methods.description: Performs multiple sequential 'sed' text substitution operations to replace specific patterns in input data, mainly shortening or encoding large strings based on predefined string segments.
